note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user account controls (Donate, Create account, Log in)
Table of contents -- renders: 'Contents' label, 'Hide' button, and section headings which are structural navigation for the page
Page title bar -- renders: page title, language selector, and 'Add section' button
Left navigation tabs -- renders: 'Article' and 'Talk' tabs
Right navigation tabs -- renders: 'Read', 'Edit', 'View history' tabs and 'Tools' menu
Appearance settings -- renders: 'Appearance' label, 'Hide' button, font size options (Small, Standard, Large), width options (Limited, Full), and theme options (OS, Day, Night)
Page subtitle -- renders: 'From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia'
Category links -- renders: 'Categories:' label and category names which are structural metadata

Page footer -- renders: last modified date, 'Rendered with MediaWiki', copyright info, and links to Privacy policy, About, Disclaimers, Contact, Legal, Code of conduct, Developers, Statistics, Cookie statement, Mobile view
